description: This file defines basic types, type aliases, and a Storage class for the PyTorch library, including type aliases for tensors, sizes, device types, and storage protocols.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: A class representing storage protocol with methods for memory management and file operations, meant to be subclassed.

methods.name: __deepcopy__
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the storage object.

methods.name: _new_shared
methods.description: Creates a new shared storage of given size.

methods.name: _write_file
methods.description: Writes storage data to a file.

methods.name: element_size
methods.description: Returns the size of each element in storage.

methods.name: _new_with_file
methods.description: Creates new storage from a file.
